description:
Here is the unified character description of Ben 10:

Benjamin Kirby "Ben" Tennyson, commonly known as Ben 10, is a 10-year-old superhero and the titular protagonist of the Ben 10 franchise. He is a reckless and adventurous child who obtains the Omnitrix, a watch-like device that allows him to transform into various alien species. As he matures throughout the series, Ben becomes a capable and responsible hero, using his powers to battle supervillains and protect the world. Ben is voiced by Tara Strong as a child and Yuri Lowenthal as a teenager. He is the grandson of Max Tennyson and cousin of Gwen Tennyson, and is known for his bravery, quick thinking, and willingness to sacrifice himself to protect others.
